name: Fox Elusion (Combat, Style)
body:
You are able to effortlessly dodge your opponent’s strikes against you by distracting it with disruptive feints.

Prerequisites: Int 13, Combat Expertise, Fox Style, Improved Feint; base attack bonus +9 or Bluff 9 ranks.

Benefit: While using this stance, increase the duration of the concealment that you gain from Fox Style by a number of rounds equal to your Charisma bonus (minimum 0).
